annotations.text:
Direction A · Refined Slate — one shared shell across all five games.
Same header (ParaDos wordmark + How to play / Share / theme toggle), same status cards, same board frame, same pill buttons. Space Grotesk + Public Sans.
Top row shows DL in DARK and LIGHT — the shared parados_theme toggle. The other four are shown dark (default); each gets the same light treatment.
Game state stays FIXED in both themes: kangaroo dishes, DL stones/board grays, MAKA LAINA discs + black/white collectors, Democracy red/blue colonies, Frankenstein body-part colours.
B / C kept for reference. A is the chosen path. Idea worth keeping from C: the capital-D block as a small logo mark — could pair with A's cleaner chrome once Walter's logo lands.
